places.name: Kluane National Park and Reserve
places.ai_summary: Kluane National Park and Reserve is a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring glaciers, mountains, and diverse wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to explore the glaciers safely.
places.address: Kluane National Park and Reserve, Yukon, Canada

places.name: Dawson City
places.ai_summary: Dawson City is a historic town known for its role in the Klondike Gold Rush and its vibrant arts scene.

opening_hours.notes: Individual attractions may have specific hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Dawson City Museum to learn about the Gold Rush history.

places.ai_summary: Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park commemorates the Klondike Gold Rush with historic sites and trails.
places.name_english: Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during special events.

places.place_tip: Hike the Chilkoot Trail for a unique experience.

places.name: Miles Canyon
places.ai_summary: Miles Canyon is a scenic canyon located just outside of Whitehorse, known for its stunning views and outdoor activities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the suspension bridge for a great photo op.

places.name: Emerald Lake
places.ai_summary: Emerald Lake is a stunningly beautiful lake located in the Yukon Territory, known for its vibrant turquoise color.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in clear weather.

places.place_tip: Visit early in the morning for the best light for photography.

attribution.title: Emerald Lake, Yukon 3
attribution.author: Wknight94
attribution.description: Emerald Lake on the Klondike Highway near Carcross, Yukon, Canada.

places.name: White Pass & Yukon Route Railway
places.ai_summary: The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway is a historic railway offering scenic train rides through the mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Advance reservations recommended.

places.place_tip: Sit on the right side of the train for the best views.
places.address: White Pass & Yukon Route Railway, Yukon, Canada

places.name: SS Klondike National Historic Site
places.ai_summary: The SS Klondike National Historic Site is a preserved sternwheeler that offers a glimpse into the riverboat era of the Klondike Gold Rush.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during winter months.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history of the ship.
places.address: SS Klondike National Historic Site, Yukon, Canada

places.name: Northern Lights Centre
places.ai_summary: The Northern Lights Centre is a visitor center in Watson Lake that provides information about the Northern Lights and local history.

opening_hours.notes: Closed from mid-May to mid-June.

places.place_tip: Check the aurora forecast before your visit.

attribution.title: Watson Lake 4
attribution.author: Timkal
attribution.description: Watson Lake airport from the air.

places.name: Yukon Wildlife Preserve
places.ai_summary: The Yukon Wildlife Preserve is a 700-acre preserve that is home to over 15 species of Yukon wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit during feeding times for the best animal sightings.

places.name: MacBride Museum of Yukon History
places.ai_summary: The MacBride Museum of Yukon History is a museum in Whitehorse that showcases the history and culture of the Yukon.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Check out the local art exhibits in addition to the permanent collection.
places.address: MacBride Museum of Yukon History, Yukon, Canada

attribution.title: The MacBride Museum of Yukon History incorporates the original Whitehorse telegraph office (47975838723)
attribution.author: dvs from Vermont, USA

places.name: Takhini Hot Springs
places.ai_summary: Takhini Hot Springs is a natural hot spring located near Whitehorse, known for its relaxing mineral-rich waters.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for private tubs.

places.place_tip: Bring a swimsuit and towel; these are not provided.

places.name: Dempster Highway
places.ai_summary: The Dempster Highway is a scenic highway that offers stunning views of the northern Yukon and access to Tombstone Territorial Park.

opening_hours.notes: Road conditions can vary; check before you travel.

places.place_tip: Drive carefully and watch for wildlife on the road.

places.name: Tombstone Territorial Park
places.ai_summary: Tombstone Territorial Park is a wilderness park known for its dramatic mountain scenery and hiking opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor center hours vary by season.

places.place_tip: Consider camping overnight to fully experience the park.

places.name: Carcross Desert
places.ai_summary: Carcross Desert is a small desert located in the Yukon, known for its unique sand dunes and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the summer months.

places.place_tip: Explore the area on foot to fully appreciate the unique landscape.

attribution.title: Carcross Desert and Nares Lake
attribution.author: Jakub Fryš
attribution.description: Sunset view on Carcross Desert and Nares Lake, Yukon, Canada

places.name: Bonanza Creek
places.ai_summary: Bonanza Creek is a historic site near Dawson City, known for its role in the Klondike Gold Rush.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in conjunction with a visit to Dawson City.

places.place_tip: Visit the Bonanza Creek Ranch for a guided tour.

places.name: Sign Post Forest
places.ai_summary: Sign Post Forest is a unique roadside attraction in Watson Lake, featuring thousands of signs from around the world.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Bring a sign from home to add to the collection.

attribution.title: Watson Lake Signpost
attribution.author: Jadecolour at English Wikipedia

places.name: Yukon Beringia Interpretive Centre
places.ai_summary: The Yukon Beringia Interpretive Centre is a museum in Whitehorse that explores the prehistoric land bridge that once connected Asia and North America.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Check out the interactive exhibits for a hands-on experience.
places.address: Yukon Beringia Interpretive Centre, Yukon, Canada

places.name: Five Finger Rapids
places.ai_summary: Five Finger Rapids is a scenic spot on the Yukon River, known for its stunning views and hiking opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the summer months.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

attribution.title: Five Finger Rapids
attribution.author: The original uploader was Jadecolour at English Wikipedia.

places.name: Kwanlin Dün Cultural Centre
places.ai_summary: The Kwanlin Dün Cultural Centre is a cultural facility in Whitehorse that showcases the heritage and culture of the Kwanlin Dün First Nation.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Sundays from May to September.

places.place_tip: Participate in a cultural workshop for a hands-on experience.
places.address: Kwanlin Dün Cultural Centre, Yukon, Canada

places.name: Ivvavik National Park
places.ai_summary: Ivvavik National Park is a remote national park in the Yukon, known for its rugged wilderness and wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Access by permit only; apply in advance.

places.place_tip: Plan your trip well in advance due to the park's remoteness.
